r_c0 is called in to assess m_c's hearing. While it seems fine at first, it quickly becomes clear m_c can't hear as well on one side.
m_c often turns {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head when listening, it's clear that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} hearing is limited in one ear.
m_c has come to notice noises are much clearer on one side than the other.
